reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: I wanted to convert my notes from a notebook into a text format on my phone but when I used ScanShot to scan it came out with a jumbled mess where I had to edit almost everything. I payed a year subscription because I read the high reviews and felt confident that I was signing up with an app that could give me what I wanted but instead I was met with disappointment. In the time it took me to edit their version of my notes I could’ve just typed it into my notes app. Not worth the money at all

reviews.title: DON’T GET
reviews.text: I downloaded this app for a quick one time use and had to pay to be able to use the actual features of the app. I paid a one time fee of 0.49. However, about a week later I saw that the app charged me 9.99 I tried to cancel my subscription within the app but there is no way to do so, so I deleted the app but they STILL continued to charge me weekly. The only way to cancel is through your App Store. I have filed a complaint with apple and requested a refund, hopefully money is returned and this app banned for being predatory and fraudulent.
